notes:
- Feature: RSI + Stochastic + Support/Resistance strategy (client text), four variants with candle size = expiry: 10 s, 15 s, 30 s, 1 min. CALL = strong support + RSI(14) < 30 + Stochastic(5,3,3) bullish crossover + bullish candle; PUT the mirror. All four required. "Strong" level = a swing point price turned at twice or more (within 0.3 ATR). No stake preset, no news pause.
- Feature: 10 s candles (Quotex's 10s chart).
- Feature: OTC data collection. The extension records 5 s candles per pair (live and from tick history). Log tab: "Collect OTC history" scrolls the chart back to fetch older prices (about 10 min per scroll), "Export 5s candles CSV" saves them. `node tools/backtest-otc.js` measures the four variants on the exported files.
